page: Microsoft Azure E4ds_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Edsv7 family, virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 4 vCPUs, derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 480 MB L3 cache, alongside 48 KB L1d and 2 MB L2 caches. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. Local storage is bundled with a 236 GB disk, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-threaded capabilities but reveal limitations in multi-threaded and memory-intensive operations. Single-threaded gzip compression at 34.96 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 14.44 GB/sec both rank in the strong category. However, the stress-ng multi-core CPU performance of 4533.06 and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression of 29.06 GB/sec are weak. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show a weak write speed of 22.41 GB/sec for large blocks and a weak read speed of 335.66 GB/sec for small cached blocks, though large block read bandwidth is average at 44.69 GB/sec. Passmark CPU and memory scores fall within the average range.

For specialized workloads, the server achieves an average static web serving throughput of 8.6 GB/sec and processes 7.86 million Redis SET operations per second. Large language model inference speeds are average for a small 135M model at 516.92 tokens per second for prompt processing, but drop to poor for a medium 7B model at 5.18 tokens per second during text generation. Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the inclusion of local storage, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive applications that do not require high multi-core scaling. Appropriate workloads include caching layers, relational databases with moderate transaction volumes, and single-threaded data processing tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure E4ds_v7 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server from the Edsv7 family, virtualized on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features a dedicated 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 4 vCPUs, 32.0 GB of RAM, and a 236 GB local storage disk. Single-threaded performance is strong, as evidenced by gzip compression and bzip3 decompression benchmarks. However, multi-core CPU scaling and memory write bandwidth are relatively weak. The server is suited for memory-bound workloads such as caching, moderate database operations, and single-threaded processing tasks that benefit from its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and local storage capacity, rather than parallelized compute-heavy applications.
